Thank you for asking! Here are the key details of our return policy:

### 📅 Return Windows (by product category)
- **Electronics:** 15 days from delivery
- **Clothing, Kitchen & Accessories:** 30 days from delivery
- **Books:** 14 days from delivery

### ⭐ Extended Windows for Members
- **Gold & Platinum members** receive an extra **+15 days** on top of the standard window.
- **Prime shipping members** get an additional **+15 days** as well.
- **Holiday orders** placed in November or December have their return window extended through **January 31** of the following year (if that gives you more time than the membership extension).
- **Store-credit grace period:** If you're up to **15 days past** your return window, you can still return the item for **store credit only**.

### ✅ Always Eligible (No Window Restriction)
- **Defective items**, items that were **wrong/not as described**, or items **damaged in transit** can be returned at any time regardless of the window.

### 💰 Restocking Fees
- A **15% restocking fee** applies to **opened electronics** returned due to a change of mind.
  - **Platinum members:** Fee fully waived
  - **Gold members:** 50% off the fee
  - **Silver members:** 25% off the fee
  - **Standard members:** No discount

### 📦 Return Shipping
- **Orders under $50:** An **$8 return shipping fee** is deducted from your refund.
- **Orders $50 and above:** **Free return shipping** — we provide a prepaid label.
- **Defective, wrong, or damaged items:** Return shipping is **always free**, regardless of order value.

### 💵 Refunds
- **Defective/wrong/damaged items:** Full refund to your original payment method.
- **Changed-mind returns within the window:** Refund to original payment method (minus any applicable fees).
- **Returns during the store-credit grace period:** Refund issued as **store credit only**.
- If a promo or coupon was used, the discount is allocated proportionally — your refund reflects the actual amount you paid for that item.

---

If you have a specific order you'd like to return, just share your order details and I'll walk you through the process!
